title: Controls that make the output usable
intro: Speed only matters if leadership and audit can trust the numbers. These controls sit behind all three workflows.

cards.title: Human in the loop
cards.text: The LLM never publishes. Commentary, risk flags and forecasts are approved by a named analyst or manager; in the demos, the variance pack and the bookings forecast cannot be released until review is complete.

cards.title: Math outside the LLM
cards.text: Variances, conversion statistics and the five-year model are calculated by Power Query and Excel, not by the language model. The LLM explains, classifies and flags.

cards.title: Data protection
cards.text: Enterprise-licensed AI with no training on company data. PII and customer names removed before processing. Nothing sensitive goes to consumer AI tools.

cards.title: Auditability
cards.text: AI-assisted content is tagged. Prompt templates are version-controlled. Analyst overrides, dismissed risk flags and forecast adjustments are logged with a reason.

cards.title: Model checks
cards.text: Models are tied out to the source workbook, and automatic checks flag results that break basic rules, such as negative new ARR or cash falling below zero.

cards.title: Accuracy tracking
cards.text: Monthly review of false positives and misses, and forecast accuracy by view (sales call, statistical, finance) against actual bookings.

whatis.job: Classifies variance drivers, drafts commentary, reads CRM notes and call transcripts to flag deal risks, drafts plan and forecast summaries.
Connects to ERP, CRM and warehouse; cleans and maps data; computes variances and historical win rates. Same input, same output.
System of record for the operating model and forecast; runs scenarios on approved assumptions.
Dashboards, drill-down, approved commentary and forecast-accuracy tracking.
Investigate flagged items, accept or dismiss AI flags, make documented adjustments, own the final numbers.
